ei.title: How Marketers Reduce Financial Risk for Consumers

fullPassage: Financial (economic, monetary) risk is the likely loss of money associated with purchasing and using a product. It includes not only the product's up-front sticker price (invoice cost or transaction price) but also costs of acquisition, ownership and maintenance, and disposal. An important financial risk reliever in the marketer's arsenal is offering a better value through a lower purchase price, giving better quality or performance for the money. There are also price protection plans, guarantees that a marketer's price is the lowest. If a consumer finds a lower price elsewhere, the marketer will match it, either before or after the purchase. In a variation, when consumers buy nonrefundable airline tickets and the fares drop before departure, most airlines refund the difference via a travel voucher for a future flight, minus the airlines ticket change fee, typically $50 to $100.

questions.passage: Financial (economic, monetary) risk is the likely loss of money associated with purchasing and using a product. It includes not only the product's up-front sticker price (invoice cost or transaction price) but also costs of acquisition, ownership and maintenance, and disposal. An important financial risk reliever in the marketer's arsenal is offering a better value through a lower purchase price, giving better quality or performance for the money. There are also price protection plans, guarantees that a marketer's price is the lowest. If a consumer finds a lower price elsewhere, the marketer will match it, either before or after the purchase. In a variation, when consumers buy __________ airline tickets and the fares drop before departure, most airlines refund the difference via a travel voucher for a future flight, minus the airlines ticket change fee, typically $50 to $100.

questions.stem: 위 글의 요약문으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마케터는 가격 인하, 최저가 보증, 환불 정책으로 소비자의 금전적 위험을 줄인다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② Marketers help consumers manage financial risk by offering competitive pricing, price-match guarantees, and fare-drop refund policies.: 핵심 세 가지 전략 포함.
❌ ① Consumers always lose money when they purchase products, and there is nothing marketers can do about it.: 마케터 수단 없다는 건 반대.
❌ ③ Airlines never refund money to consumers who buy nonrefundable tickets.: 바우처로 차액 환불함.
❌ ④ Financial risk includes only the sticker price and nothing else.: 정가만이 아님.
det.tip: 요약 = 가격 인하+보증+환불로 소비자 위험 완화.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마케터가 가격과 품질 양면에서 소비자의 금전적 부담을 줄여준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ Marketers reduce consumers' financial burden through both pricing and quality improvements.: 가격 인하+품질 향상 두 가지가 핵심.
❌ ① Consumers should always choose the cheapest products regardless of quality.: 무조건 최저가가 아님.
❌ ② Marketers always sacrifice quality to lower prices.: 품질 희생이 아닌 향상.
❌ ③ Higher prices always guarantee better product performance.: 높은 가격=더 나은 성능 아님.
det.tip: better value = 더 나은 가치 = 낮은 가격 또는 높은 품질/성능.
